results.content:
Polls confirm Trump’s decline. The Economist’s poll tracker put his net approval rating at minus-25 points. RealClearPolitics’ average of polls shows that 59 percent of voters now disapprove of Trump’s performance as president.

In Fox polls, Trump is in negative territory on the economy, the war in Iran, and even on immigration, the issue he rode to great success in the 2024 election. Now, 57 percent of voters disapprove of his handling of that issue. [...] CNN polls show Trump losing traction with his base. Among white voters with no college degrees, he has fallen from 61 percent approval in February of last year to a current level of 46 percent.
